country: Jordan, Palestine, Lebanon, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Libya

links.outcome: Pharmacy students' and faculty's AI knowledge and receipt of AI education or training
links.effect: Only 39.5% had a good understanding of AI concepts; mean knowledge score 42.3 ± 21.8 out of 100; only 18.6% had received AI education or training.
links.quote: However, only a minority (18.6%) reported having received education or training on AI technology.

screen.reason: This is a multinational cross-sectional survey examining knowledge, attitudes, and practices (KAP) regarding AI among pharmacy students and faculty.
